intro: Crosbie House is a non-profit residential treatment program that provides recovery services for individuals and families suffering from addiction. The dedicated team of physicians, addiction specialists, and volunteers at Crosbie believe that recovery is possible for everyone. The 4-week program includes 1-on-1 counseling sessions, extensive group therapy, acupuncture, art therapy, physical activity, smudging, and 12-step recovery meetings. Crosbie House believes in healing the mind, body, and spirit from the effects of addiction.

The program’s aftercare services include an alumni program, which helps transition individuals back into daily life. Crosbie House also provides an extensive family group program that offers support and education for family members. The family program is held once a week and includes 1-on-1 counseling for family members. Crosbie House provides its clients with a clear path towards recovery, providing them the tools needed to sustain sobriety and achieve lasting results.

pillars.title: Location and Facilities of Crosbie House
pillars.body: Situated in the Annapolis Valley, Crosbie House provides a home-like environment for its clients. The sprawling resident grounds create a private and serene setting, offering plenty of space for walking with nearby trails to immerse oneself in the healing power of nature. Yoga, meditation, and physical fitness are all available on-site at the Crosbie House. Clients can experience a tranquil and peaceful environment as they work towards achieving their recovery goals. The facilities at Crosbie House are designed to promote a comfortable and welcoming environment. Meals are prepared on site by a catering service, using only the freshest ingredients, sourced locally. The design and décor of the facilities create a warm and inviting atmosphere, promoting a sense of tranquility and peace.

pillars.title: Approach to Treatment at Crosbie House
pillars.body: Crosbie House takes a holistic approach towards addiction treatment, focusing on healing the mind, body, and spirit. The program’s approach to treatment includes 1-on-1 counseling sessions, extensive group therapy, acupuncture, art therapy, physical activity, smudging, and 12-step recovery meetings. Through these various treatment modalities, clients learn coping skills that help them manage cravings and triggers that can lead to relapse. The program’s approach to treatment is centered around creating a safe and supportive environment for clients. The team of addiction specialists, physicians, and volunteers works together to provide individualized care to meet the unique needs of each client. The program’s aftercare services are designed to help clients transition back into daily life, providing them with the resources they need to maintain their sobriety.

pillars.title: Physicians, Counsellors and Alumni Who Know Recovery
pillars.body: Crosbie House opened in 1978 and takes its name from its first medical director, the late Dr. Jack Crosbie. Today the medical director is Dr. David Saunders, a former family doctor who trained in addiction medicine at CAMH in Toronto, and Dr. Jim Rafferty, who lives in recovery himself, serves as medical consultant. Program manager Adam Lewis is a Canadian Certified Addiction Counsellor and a Crosbie alumnus. The centre says most of its staff are in recovery, and a volunteer board, some of them Crosbie graduates, runs the society without pay.

overview: Crosbie House Society is a highly-regarded Non-Profit rehab facility situated in the tranquil town of New Minas, Nova Scotia. Known for its exceptional quality of care, Crosbie House Society is dedicated to helping those who struggle with substance, drug, and alcohol abuse as well as mental health issues. Their team of experienced professionals is passionate about providing personalized treatment plans tailored to suit each patient’s unique needs.

Crosbie House Society offers an array of services and amenities to help patients achieve their recovery goals. Along with specialized 12 Step Programs, the center offers holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga, and meditation to promote overall well-being. Additionally, the center provides individual, family, and group therapy, and counseling sessions along with nutritional counseling and art and nature therapy. The facility’s comprehensive range of amenities ensures that patients receive the highest level of care for their overall physical and emotional well-being.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Crosbie House cost?
faqs.a: Crosbie House charges $10,800 for its 28-day inpatient program, a price in effect since July 1, 2023, and that includes two years of aftercare and support. There is no extra charge for its supplementary programs or services. A non-refundable $1,000 deposit secures a bed, and payment terms can be arranged by calling 1-866-681-0613.
Crosbie House is a non-profit residential treatment program that provides recovery services for individuals and families suffering from addiction.

faqs.q: How long is the program at Crosbie House?
faqs.a: The program at Crosbie House is 4 weeks long, and a 6-week (42-day) option is also offered.

Crosbie House asks for a detoxification period before admission. If you need withdrawal management, call 1-866-681-0613 and the centre will arrange an assessment with one of its physicians. The centre notes that in some cases a medically supervised detox is the safest option.

faqs.q: What is included in the 4-week program at Crosbie House?
faqs.a: The program includes 1-on-1 counseling sessions, extensive group therapy, acupuncture, art therapy, physical activity, smudging, and 12-step recovery meetings.

faqs.q: Where is Crosbie House and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Crosbie House is at 113 Cornwallis Avenue in New Minas, in Nova Scotia's Annapolis Valley, about an hour's drive from Halifax and from Halifax Stanfield International Airport. It is the last house on the road, on the outskirts of the village, with a green belt next door and the hospital close by. Kentville and Wolfville are each a short drive away.

faqs.q: Is Crosbie House private? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes. Crosbie House is a private not-for-profit, fee-for-service centre, and no public funding is available. Many private Canadian insurers cover addiction treatment and Crosbie will supply the documents they ask for, but you pay at admission unless your insurer confirms in writing that it will pay. Employers often help through occupational health, an EAP or a payroll deduction.

faqs.q: What is the aftercare program at Crosbie House?
faqs.a: The aftercare program at Crosbie House includes an alumni program that helps transition individuals back into daily life.

You leave with an aftercare plan, contacts in the recovery community and Crosbie's 24/7 help line. Staff call you from time to time, and alumni can join relapse prevention workshops, family seminars, monthly webcasts, on-site 12-step meetings and the annual Crosbie picnic. Two years of aftercare are included in the fee.

faqs.q: Does Crosbie House treat gambling addiction?
faqs.a: Yes. Crosbie House treats alcohol, drug and gambling addictions, and part of the counselling is specific to each client's drug or behaviour of choice.

faqs.q: How does Crosbie House support family members?
faqs.a: Crosbie House provides an extensive family group program that offers support and education for family members. The family group program is held once a week and includes 1-on-1 counseling for family members.

faqs.q: How soon can I be admitted?
faqs.a: New clients arrive every week, and an addiction counsellor takes admission calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. For employer referrals, the centre says assessments are normally done within 48 hours and admission usually follows within a week.

faqs.q: What facilities are available at Crosbie House?
faqs.a: Facilities at Crosbie House include walking trails, yoga, meditation, physical fitness, and meals prepared on site by a catering service using only the freshest ingredients sourced locally.
